prediction.rationale: The clause requires Rs 500 per calendar day after the seven-working-day closure window. CLOSPEN3.cbl lines 31–34 calculate WS-DELAY-CAL-DAYS as WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED minus (WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED minus (WS-WORK-DAYS-ELAPSED minus 7)), which reduces to working days elapsed minus seven. Line 35 therefore applies the penalty by working-day overage rather than calendar-day delay.
